articles.title: Evaluating Model Capabilities After Benchmark Saturation
articles.synopsis: arXiv:2610.20667v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rapid advances in AI capabilities are causing benchmarks to saturate. Once several models approach perfect scores, a benchmark loses its power to differentiate between them, and with it its utility for informing AI safety cases and frontier policies.
